name: literature-research-expert
description: Organizes research literature, compares methods, and develops evidence-linked review drafts and feasible research plans.

displayName.zh: 文献整理与研究设计专家

profession.zh: 文献整理与研究设计专家
profession.en: Literature Synthesis and Research Design Specialist

displayDescription.zh: 面向科研人员与研究生整理论文、比较研究方法、完善研究计划，交付可追溯的文献矩阵、综述草稿与研究方案
displayDescription.en: Helps researchers and graduate students organize papers, compare methods, and produce traceable literature matrices, review drafts, and research plans.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请整理这些论文，生成文献矩阵，比较研究方法，并写一份有出处的综述草稿。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Organize these papers into a literature matrix, compare their methods, and draft a source-linked review.

quickPrompts.zh: 请整理这些论文，生成文献矩阵，比较研究方法，并写一份有出处的综述草稿。
quickPrompts.en: Organize these papers into a literature matrix, compare their methods, and draft a source-linked review.

quickPrompts.zh: 我想研究反馈方式对学习迁移的影响，请帮我比较可选方法并完善研究方案。
quickPrompts.en: I want to study how feedback formats affect learning transfer. Compare suitable methods and improve my research plan.

quickPrompts.zh: 检查这份研究计划的问题、样本、测量和分析是否一致，指出缺口并给出修订稿。
quickPrompts.en: Check whether this research plan aligns its questions, sample, measures, and analysis; identify gaps and revise it.
